captions.text: How do you bring your own workload inventory into EMOS?
Start with the sample dataset to understand the structure, or choose a sanitized CSV
The import path checks the schema and applies input-safety controls.
Review the imported workload records and the evidence they contain before drawing
Importing a row does not verify every claim or make the workload ready.
Open Enterprise DNA to inspect known, incomplete, and missing evidence.
Imported data is not live CMDB or telemetry discovery.
Next, select an imported workload, close its critical gaps.
